title: NZ and ROM in AR, LB, FE after 20-min denucleation, normalised to intact (lumbar ACUs)

quantity.name: NZ and ROM relative to intact
quantity.definition: NZ and one-direction ROM after denucleation divided by the same specimen's intact value; mean ± SD (upper whisker); NZ and ROM are separate data items

source.authors: Cannella M, Arthur A, Allen S, Keane M, Joshi A, Vresilovic E, Marcolongo M
source.sample: 12 cadaveric anterior column units in two data sets of 6 (DS1: 2 T12-L1, 2 L2-L3, 2 L4-L5; DS2: L1-L2, L2-L3, L3-L4, 3 L4-L5); human cadaver ACUs (posterior elements removed), no severe degeneration

protocol.summary: ACUs potted in Smooth-Cast 300 on a servohydraulic frame (Instron 8874); DS2 in a Spenciner-type pure-moment jig (6-DOF load cell, XY table; ~5% off-axis loads), DS2 displacements corrected for jig stiffness (1700 N/mm, 30 Nm/deg torsion, 10 Nm/deg bending). DS1: preconditioning 50 cycles at 3% disc height (1 Hz), then axial 150 N tension to 1500 N compression, 5 cycles, 0.1 Hz; nucleus pressure needle (14 G, transducer) through the anterior annulus, tip in the nucleus at half the minor-axis length from the outer wall. DS2: preconditioning 50 cycles 50-150 N compression (1 Hz), then separately axial 150 N tension to 1000 N compression and ±7.5 Nm AR, LB, FE, 5 sinusoidal cycles at 0.1 Hz. 5th cycle analysed. Neutral position = midpoint of zero-load positions of loading/unloading; NZ = difference between loading and unloading curves at zero load (Wilke 1998); ROM = maximum displacement/rotation in one direction from neutral.
how_to_simulate: Model a lumbar disc-only unit (vertebral bodies + disc, no posterior elements); fix the inferior body
Apply ±7.5 Nm pure moments in axial rotation, lateral bending and flexion-extension, no preload (5 cycles, use the 5th)
Report ROM (max rotation in each direction from the neutral midpoint) and NZ (loading-unloading gap at zero moment) separately
protocol.notes: Resection steps (posterolateral 2 mm automated Nucleotome, under 50 N compression): DS1 intact -> intact with pressure needle -> denucleation 5, 10, 15, 20 min cumulative (dry nucleus removed ~37/60/84/100% of the 20-min amount; 20 min ≈ 0.15 g dry); DS2 intact -> single 20-min denucleation. Values after denucleation are normalised to the same specimen's intact value (relative, not absolute).

extraction.check_notes: Matches text: NZ +150% AR (2.58), +165% LB (2.67), +140% FE (2.42); ROM +57-68% AR (1.59/1.70), +33-26% LB (1.35/1.28), +37% FE (1.39/1.39). | verified 2026-11-12 sign check: OK (Table 2 p4 / Fig 5 p5 images: all quantities are magnitudes or ratios, no negative values; tension load -100 N correctly signed)
